@graph.name: CO2 Fractional Laser
@graph.description: Visit Derma Solutions for Best Fractional CO2 Laser Skin Resurfacing in Bangalore for acne scars, wrinkles, skin discoloration. Book your appointment today!
@graph.howPerformed: Treatment starts with a detailed consultation and skin assessment. The treatment area is then cleansed and numbed with a topical anesthetic. The CO2 laser is applied to the targeted areas in fractional beams, followed by a soothing gel or cooling mask. You'll receive clear post-treatment care instructions for good healing and results.

acceptedAnswer.text: A topical numbing cream is applied before the procedure, so discomfort is kept to a minimum.

mainEntity.name: How many sessions will I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most patients need 3–5 sessions for optimal results.

mainEntity.name: What is the downtime after the treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expect mild redness and peeling for 5–7 days while the skin heals. Sun protection is essential during recovery.

mainEntity.name: Is this treatment safe for all skin types?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our dermatologists customize the laser settings to each skin type for safe, effective treatment.
